problem: A Bedrijfsgeheugen LinkedIn company story could repeat on a later day even though the atomic single-writer guard prevented same-claim concurrency duplicates.
root_cause: The durable story fingerprint was only generated for linkedin_personal. LinkedIn company therefore depended on text similarity while its measured campaign URL changes by publication date and can weaken historical matching.
fix: Generate the durable story fingerprint for linkedin_company as well and canonicalize company text before uniqueness reservation by removing URLs, hashtags, date markers and whitespace noise.
prevention: Apply historical story fingerprints to both linkedin_personal and linkedin_company.
Canonicalize date-varying measured-link noise before company uniqueness reservation.
Fail closed before any provider write when an exact or near-duplicate historical story is detected.
Preserve the existing atomic claim, capability consumption and provider-side-effect terminality.
Project this incident permanently into AGENTS.md, Powerhouse continuity, the LinkedIn publication skill and the canonical System Map so future chats/agents cannot regress.
